title: Pinocchio: Easy English Story for Beginners
description: You can read the full story of Pinocchio here. Tap a word to see its meaning. It is level A1 and takes about 3 minutes to read. Enjoy!
intro: A wooden puppet comes to life, but he tells lies, runs away and gets into trouble, until he learns what a good son does. The sentences are short and simple, so the story suits A1 learners.
